name: carl-avidano-ux-astro
description: Rebuild the Carl Avidano UX portfolio as a clean Astro site powered by Natura11y, preserving the current content and design while removing Gatsby.
author: Carl Avidano

scripts.build: npm test && npm run check && astro build && npm run check:site-links
scripts.build:review: npm test && npm run check && APPLICATION_PREVIEW=true astro build --outDir dist-review && node scripts/check-site-links.mjs --review
